## Fix

```go
// Windows are half-open: an instant exactly on a boundary starts a new
// window (see docs/pipeline.md). So a window [start, start+Size) owns the
// instants start <= t < start+Size, and Start is floor division by Size.
func Start(unix int64) int64 {
	return (unix / Size) * Size
}
```

This implements `[start, start+width)` exactly: `59 → 0`, `60 → 60`, `119 → 60`, `120 → 120`.

## Verification

- **`go test ./...`** — passes (exit 0, 185 packages, no FAIL lines).
- **Boundary test** — added `TestStartBucketsBoundaryInstants` in `internal/window/window_test.go` covering an instant exactly on a boundary starting the next window (`0`, `60`, `120`) and an instant one second before a boundary staying in the ending window (`59`, `119`), plus a mid-window sanity case (`175`). The existing mid-window test also now passes (`Start(119)` was failing before the fix).
- **End-to-end CLI** — with events at `59/60/75/119/120`:

  ```
  t=0 hits 5    # 59 stays in [0,60)
  t=60 hits 8   # 60 (boundary), 75, 119
  t=120 hits 2  # 120 (boundary)
  ```

Nothing else in the pipeline (parser, rollup sink, report rendering) needed changing — they all just pass the window start through.
